summary: Connect joint coordinates to an articulated arm and inspectable endpoint frame.
objective: Build a three-joint arm with joint sliders and visible base and tool frames derived from forward kinematics.
intent_signals: move a joint and see endpoint pose
example_prompts: Build a three-joint arm with joint sliders and visible base and tool frames derived from forward kinematics.
Show how changing the first joint moves downstream links while their lengths remain fixed.

entities.name: Robot links
entities.guidance: Use a fixed base, explicit joint-axis housings and rigid links with declared lengths.

entities.name: Tool and frames
entities.guidance: Attach a small tool flange and labeled right-handed axis triads at base and tool.

object_craft.structure: Use a fixed base, explicit joint-axis housings and rigid links with declared lengths.
object_craft.material: Powder-coated links with dark joint caps.

object_craft.structure: Attach a small tool flange and labeled right-handed axis triads at base and tool.
object_craft.material: Distinct axis colors with x/y/z labels.
object_craft.articulation: Each link transform derives from the upstream joint chain.

state_contract.model: Declared open-chain kinematic model with home transform M, ordered joint axes and joint coordinate vector; use one documented transform convention.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Edit one joint within authored bounds.

invariants: Zero joint coordinates recover home transform M.
Endpoint frame and visible tool use the same transform.
Changing an upstream joint cannot stretch a rigid downstream link.
motion_guidance: Use bounded joint-speed interpolation for playback; evaluate transforms from joint state every update.
Three.js companion tooling renders frames, pivots and picking; a kinematics routine owns matrix composition and units.
known_limits: Kinematic teaching arm with authored dimensions, not calibrated industrial hardware.
No torque, payload, collision avoidance or controller safety claim.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.

claims.statement: Forward kinematics maps an open-chain robot joint-coordinate vector to the end-effector frame relative to a fixed space frame; the home configuration is the zero-joint transform.
claims.scope: Open-chain rigid-link kinematics with declared joint axes and coordinate conventions.

source_refs.locator: Transcript paragraphs defining forward kinematics, home configuration M and final general procedure

colliders: Optional link envelopes for visible interference warnings, not a planner.
driving: Joint sliders and bounded speed tracks.
contact: No contact response or actuator forces.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Home transform equality; tool/frame agreement; fixed link lengths.
